what: Each digit place has a vertical 0~9 strip. When the value changes, only the strip of the changed place rolls by that digit’s height (1em × digit) over .7s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1). Commas and dots stay as they are at half opacity (.5), and places are anchored from the right so lower places never break when the digit count grows. With live set, after entering the screen it counts up by step every (.4~2.2) × live ms like a living counter, and elements with the same key roll to the same value (two marquee sets).

options.data-value: (attribute) current value — change it and it rolls. The initial value is also read from here
options.decimals: Number of decimal places — if given, toFixed is used, if not, thousands separators
options.dur · ease: Roll duration (s) · curve of four numbers, default .7 · 0.22,1,0.36,1
options.live: Base interval for auto-advance (ms) — 0 (default) means no auto-advance (Brand number strip 1800)
options.key: Names to share the same value

note: Font turns on tabular-nums. Slot height is 1em, so the parent sets the line height

from.where: index.html .m-stats (Agents at work today number strip) · .m-hero__badge (Agent traffic 77.4051%) · pricing.html price numbers (monthly/yearly toggle)
index.html .am-count (case count ”27 Cases” — original slot-digit: when the list appears it rolls from 00 and settles over 1200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))

question.html .vf-q__page (page-number plate ”2/7” covering the card when moving between questions — in the original the current number slides out upward (downward when going back) and the next number rises in, .6s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94). Since it moves one step at a time, it behaves like a rolling strip)
